selection.policy: Teacher-relative active error replaces baseline-preservation drift as a gate. Existing-source mel guard retained; no automatic promotion.

canonical_panel.evaluation_policy: Separate corrected encoder domain; original historical tensors, counts and masks remain unchanged

identity.scope: Existing plain head only with raw sample-pooled teacher L1 and unchanged long mel; explicit FIT-only parameter-gradient calibration and actual AdamW update audits. No MSE normalization, regional weighting, WN, short mel, GAN, new layer or automatic promotion.

coefficient-calibration.policy: Fixed median of per-batch raw-L1/long-mel gradient norm ratios over all four existing head parameters. Explicit FIT-only panel; zero norms disclosed and excluded, nonfinite values rejected. No regional or signal normalization, epsilon division, adaptive balancer or output-gradient coefficient.

rate-calibration.policy: Explicit FIT-only panel. Independent fresh-state AdamW updates from the retained candidate, with full-state restoration and actual gradient-dot-displacement/finite-loss evidence. At most six halvings; unchanged v2 teacher quality entry checks and strict endpoint checks.

aggregate_direction.policy: Mean unweighted wave/mel loss changes over isolated updates, all measured against the same complete training-only panel. No per-batch monotonicity requirement. FP64 dot-product tolerance=64eps times absolute products; FP32 finite-loss allowance=4eps times branch scale. Adverse predicted direction stops for review; only finite-step or quality failure can trigger a rate halving.

actual_update_probe.policy: Pre-update raw branch gradients dotted with the actual AdamW weight displacement, including clipping and supplied optimizer moments/decay. Same-panel losses measured after the finite step. Complete model/optimizer/gradient/mode/RNG state restored; this is not an SGD-direction approximation.

quality_checks.policy: Disposable finite-update entry check: teacher errors and aggregate peak permit at most 1% movement (peak +2e-6 numerical tolerance); overshoot count/source guards retained. Final selection/canonical peak rules remain strict. No old-student displacement gate or required 10% quiet improvement per calibration step.

source_spectral.policy: Each source overall mel is a gate; quiet/active/transition windows are additionally reported without synthetic joins.
